steps.clue: Travel to Omega Base and activate the three Aether Reactors to restore power.
Obtain Ravenov’s ID Badge, concoct the truth serum and use it on Peck.
Capture three Mimics with Essence Traps to obtain the Floppy Disk.
Insert the Floppy Disk and open the Omega Portal Chamber.
Use the Aethermeter, shovel and RAI K-84 to recover the three Aetherium Crystals.
Place the crystals inside the Aether Reactors and return to the Portal Chamber.
Align the satellite with Requiem’s signal.
Activate the portal and rescue Maxis.
Return to the village and defeat Orda.
